description: Fix 7 issues found during code review: GC tracing gaps (ObjFunction, ObjUpvalue, ObjBoundMethod), map delete tombstone, stack overflow check, shift operand range check, and value_to_string recursion depth limit.
steps: Fix gc_trace_object to trace ObjFunction name and chunk.constants
Fix gc_trace_object to trace ObjUpvalue.closed value
Implement tombstone sentinel for map delete to preserve probe chains
Add stack overflow check in vm_push
Add range check for shift operands in OP_SHL/OP_SHR
Add recursion depth limit to value_to_string
acceptance_criteria: GC correctly traces through ObjFunction name and constants
Map delete with colliding keys still allows lookup of remaining keys
Stack overflow produces a runtime error instead of UB
Shift by negative or >= 64 produces a runtime error instead of UB
Deeply nested or self-referencing collections in value_to_string do not cause C stack overflow
verification: Run 'make test' and confirm all tests pass
